name: Polite Frog 59
author: Programming-School-Pro-Coding
description: Gradient rounded amber button that reacts on hover.
howItWorks: Its CSS has no :hover rule that changes a visible property; hovering it shows no change.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Polite Frog 59</title>
<style>
/* Polite Frog 59 by Programming-School-Pro-Coding — https://uiverse.io/Programming-School-Pro-Coding/polite-frog-59 */
button {
  --c1: #f6d365;
  --c2: #fda085;
  padding: 15px 30px;
  text-align: center;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  transition: 0.5s;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--c1, #f6d365), var(--c2, #fda085) 51%, var(--c1, #f6d365)) var(--x, 0)/ 200%;
  color: white;
  border-radius: 20px;
  outline: none;
}

button:hover {
  --x: 100%;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button> Button
</button>

</body>
